name_reason: Suffix _17 is the legitimate spell ID 0x17 (domain ID, keep) confirmed by fd2_deduct_caster_mp(caster,0x17), dispatch-table entry index 0x17 (btltab.c /* 0x17 */), and caller dispatch on effect_code==0x17. The descriptor _complex is vague and reflects nothing about behavior. Three independent sources establish this is the Teleport support spell (傳送術): fd2-knowledge spell 0x17 = 傳送術 (輔助法術); the secondary-position globals resolve to data_fd2_battle_teleport_dest_world_x/y; the body calls fd2_animate_warp_teleport_char twice and pans to the teleport destination tile. Propose fd2_cast_spell_17_teleport: matches fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>, keeps the meaningful spell ID, replaces 'complex' with the established semantic 'teleport'. NOTE for Stage 2: rename touches protos.h decl, btltab.c dispatch table entry 0x17 AND its prose comment at btltab.c:310, and status.c references.
purpose: Cast handler for spell 0x17 (傳送術 / Teleport support spell): pans cursor to target, deducts caster MP, accumulates XP credit from the target's status byte plus a job-class bonus, then plays two warp/teleport animations (at the target's current position and at the teleport destination tile) toggling the battle anim phase.
logic_summary: Reads target_id = *p_target_byte; pans cursor to it; deducts caster MP for spell 0x17. Indexes the runtime_char array by target_id (stride 0x50). base_dmg = target->status_flags_block[0] (struct +0x21 byte); if target's job_id is in 9..24 inclusive, adds a job-class bonus of 0x1E (30). pending_xp_credit += base_dmg * 10. Plays fd2_animate_warp_teleport_char at the target's current (pos_x,pos_y) with 0xFF,0xFF markers, sets anim_phase=0, pans (animated) to the teleport destination (teleport_dest_world_x/y), plays a second warp/teleport at that destination, then sets anim_phase=1. param_2 is forwarded only to the Watcom __CHK stack-check intrinsic and is otherwise unused in the body.
signature: void __cdecl fd2_cast_spell_17_complex(uint32 caster, uint32 spell_arg, uint32 p_target_byte)

params.name: caster
params.semantics: Caster unit id; forwarded to fd2_deduct_caster_mp(caster, 0x17) to deduct the caster's MP for casting spell 0x17.
params.reason: Accurately describes the value: the caster's unit id used for MP deduction. No address residue, matches usage.

params.name: spell_arg
params.semantics: Caller (fd2_apply_use_effect_dispatch effect_code==0x17 branch) passes target_count here. In the body it is referenced only by __CHK(0x1c,...,param_1,(byte*)param_2) — the Watcom stack-check intrinsic ABI artifact — and is never used as real data.
params.reason: Generic placeholder 'spell_arg' does not reflect the actual caller value. Caller passes target_count (the per-target dispatch's count). Although the body never meaningfully consumes it (only __CHK), target_count is the accurate name. Low-stakes; defer rename to Stage 2 with the function-name rename.

params.name: p_target_byte
params.semantics: Pointer to the target id byte; dereferenced as *(uint8*)p_target_byte to get target_id, used to pan cursor, index runtime_char array, and select the warp/teleport target.
params.reason: Accurately describes a pointer to the target id byte; matches body usage. No address residue.

returns.semantics: No return value. Side effects: accumulates data_fd2_battle_pending_xp_credit, deducts caster MP, plays two warp/teleport animations, sets data_fd2_battle_anim_phase (0 then 1).
